name: Oxford PV
description: Oxford University spin-off commercialising perovskite-silicon tandem solar cells (module milestones 26.9 percent 2024, 25.6 percent shingled 2026); first commercial panels shipped to a US utility-scale project in 2024, production in Brandenburg, Germany.

sources.note: Tandem efficiency and delivery search-verified via web search 2026-10-30
